id: title:Gilbert09:say when an azure files url points at a missing blob

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion error handling and regression protection
review.reason: The change adds a user-facing error message and a corresponding test assertion for warehouse ingestion failures. P1.F1.H1 provides clearer guidance to users when a blob is missing, while P1.F2.H1 adds a regression test. This represents a localized maintenance and support improvement rather than a broad systemic capability or critical reliability fix.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based solely on the supplied error message and test assertion. No implementation, configuration, or broader context is supplied, so the score does not account for potential implementation complexity or broader architectural changes.

observations.limitations: Only error message and test assertion changes are supplied; no implementation, configuration, or broader context. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new error message and its user-facing explanation.
observations.code_quote: "The specified blob does not exist": "The file in your files URL doesn't exist in the container. Check the container name and file path, then try again.",
observations.posthog_connection: Provides clearer user guidance when a warehouse ingestion fails due to a missing blob, potentially improving support and reducing confusion.

observations.behavior: Adds a test case for a Parquet parsing failure with a missing blob, including the specific exception and classification.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds regression protection for warehouse ingestion failures, potentially improving reliability and support diagnostics.
